summary: One concrete defect remains in the option-F savings calculation. No material defect identified in the tick-rejection implementation.

findings.evidence: Option F counts a cache as saved whenever the reset falls within the allowed wait, without checking cache expiry. The reported 60-minute saving ($4.68, thr_jwz544abwe) demonstrates this: hilos.jsonl.gz records its last nonzero usage at 2026-11-02 13:09:54 UTC and its switch at 13:56:46; agotadas.jsonl.gz places joytorm's Fable reset at 14:40 UTC. Waiting roughly 43 minutes meets this condition, but the cache would already be about 90 minutes old. With the documented one-hour TTL, that rewrite is not saved.
findings.fix: Require the projected restart after reset to precede cache expiry, using fin_prev and TTL, including any restart buffer. Add this historical case as a regression and correct the option-F figures in the plan.
